name: Cohiba Maduros 5 Genios
description:
Buy Cohiba Maduros 5 Genios online  – Cohiba Maduro 5 Genios for sale

DESCRIPTION

To begin with, Box of 25, 5 1/2 x 52 Cohiba Maduros 5 Genios, Maduro 5 is the new line this year added to the Cohiba. The genuine thing about these cigars is the Five year aging process in which all the leaves come from . The Genios are special because they are the largest of the bunch, entirely new size that fits perfectly for the new age smoker.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

WEIGHT 1 lbs

DIMENSIONS

Overview: Cohiba Maduro 5 Genios

Secondly Cohiba Maduro 5 Genios is a Robusto Extra, measuring at 140mm with a 50 gauge, Genios are the largest of the Maduro range. Cohiba introduced the Linea Maduro 5 collection in 2007, unique to all 3 cigars in this range, the tobacco wrapper is the Dark Maduro leaf.

This leaf grows at the very top of shade grown plants, requiring an additional ageing and fermentation process over the course of 5 years, resulting in a sweeter flavour and inspiring the name of this collection. Filled with the signature tobacco blend exclusive to Cohiba, all of their vitolas are Totalmente a Mano, Tripa Larga – long filler, hand made, in the famous El Laguito factory.

Cohiba Maduros 5 Genios

Thirdly, The aromas are lively with cinnamon and honey at the top, the rich flavours developed as we smoked initially displaying notes of coffee and roasted tobacco, later developing into chocolate and touches of nutty nougat.
